about: Brain Arcade maze (cloze) items. Exactly one ___ per text; 3 options; answer is an index into options. From g 2.0 many items are short passages with the blank in the last sentence.

items.text: The cat will ___ on the bed.
items.why: A cat can nap on a bed.

items.text: A hen can lay an ___.
items.why: A hen lays an egg.

items.text: I can ___ with my eyes.
items.why: You see with your eyes.

items.text: The pig likes to roll in the ___.
items.why: Pigs like to roll in mud.

items.text: A fish can swim in a ___.
items.why: A fish swims in a pond.

items.text: Ice is cold, but fire is ___.
items.why: Fire is hot.

items.text: A cow gives us ___.
items.why: A cow gives us milk.

items.text: I use a pen to ___.
items.why: You write with a pen.

items.text: Fish live in the ___.
items.why: Fish live in water.

items.text: My dog likes to chase the ___.
items.why: Dogs like to chase a ball.

items.text: Mom can ___ the car to the shop.
items.why: You drive a car.

items.text: Snow is white and ___.
items.why: Snow is cold.

items.text: Before you eat, be sure to ___ your hands.
items.why: You wash your hands before you eat.

items.text: We plant seeds in the ___.
items.why: Seeds go in the dirt.

items.text: I hang my coat on a ___.
items.why: You hang a coat on a hook.

items.text: At night, the stars shine in the ___.
items.why: Stars shine in the sky.

items.text: A bird has two wings and a ___.
items.why: A bird has a beak.

items.text: The clock tells us the ___.
items.why: A clock tells the time.

items.text: Tom was very hungry, so he ate a big ___.
items.why: A hungry boy eats lunch.

items.text: Mia was so sleepy that she went to ___.
items.why: A sleepy girl goes to bed.

items.text: The kitten drank a bowl of warm ___.
items.why: Kittens drink milk.

items.text: Dad cut the paper with ___.
items.why: Scissors cut paper.

items.text: When it rains, I use an ___ to stay dry.
items.why: An umbrella keeps the rain off you.

items.text: The lion let out a loud ___.
items.why: A lion makes a loud roar.

items.text: After the rain, we saw a pretty ___.
items.why: A rainbow shows up after rain.

items.text: A turtle moves very ___.
items.why: Turtles move slowly.

items.text: The teacher gave each child a ___ to write with.
items.why: You write with a pencil.

items.text: Max put on his boots to walk in the ___.
items.why: Boots keep your feet dry in mud.

items.text: The sun was so bright that Kai needed his ___.
items.why: Sunglasses help in bright sun.

items.text: Sam was sad because his balloon floated up into the ___.
items.why: A balloon can float up into the sky.

items.text: Ava planted a seed, and soon it began to ___.
items.why: A seed grows into a plant.

items.text: The class lined up quietly to go to ___.
items.why: The class went to lunch.

items.text: The ice cream melted because the day was so ___.
items.why: Ice cream melts on a hot day.

items.text: Dad's glasses help him ___ the small words in his book.
items.why: Glasses help you see.

items.text: Dad turned on the heater because the room was ___.
items.why: A heater warms a chilly room.

items.text: Mia forgot her umbrella. When the rain started, she got ___.
items.why: Without an umbrella, Mia got soaked.

items.text: Ana had a loose tooth. It wiggled and wiggled until it finally fell ___.
items.why: A loose tooth falls out.

items.text: Omar's puppy chewed his shoe. Omar was a little mad, but he still gave the puppy a ___.
items.why: Omar gave the puppy a hug.

items.text: Mia's grandma lives far away. They talk by video so they can ___ each other's faces.
items.why: Video lets them see each other.

items.text: The sky grew dark and the wind began to blow. Soon a big ___ rolled in.
items.why: Dark sky and wind mean a storm.

items.text: The farmer woke up before sunrise to ___ the cows.
items.why: Farmers milk cows.

items.text: Lily saved her coins in a jar for months. At last she had enough money to buy a ___.
items.why: You can buy a bike with saved money.

items.text: The puppy was so small that it could fit in Sam's ___.
items.why: A tiny puppy can fit in a backpack.

items.text: Kai wanted to bake a cake. First, he ___ the eggs and flour.
items.why: You mix eggs and flour for a cake.

items.text: Rosa's shoes were covered in mud. Before going inside, she wiped them on the ___.
items.why: You wipe muddy shoes on a mat.

items.text: The little seed was buried deep in the dirt. With sun and rain, it sprouted into a tall ___.
items.why: A seed sprouts into a plant.

items.text: The library was very quiet. Everyone ___ when they talked.
items.why: People whisper in a quiet library.

items.text: Rosa studied hard for her spelling test. When she got her paper back, she was ___.
items.why: Hard work made Rosa proud.

items.text: The magician pulled a rabbit out of his hat. The children ___ with joy.
items.why: Kids cheer at a fun trick.

items.text: The campers walked for hours. By the time they reached the lake, their legs were ___.
items.why: Walking for hours makes legs tired.

items.text: Because it was Mia's birthday, her friends came to her house for a ___.
items.why: Friends come to a birthday party.

items.text: Nora's frog escaped from its box. She looked under the bed and behind the couch, but she could not ___ it.
items.why: She looked everywhere but could not find it.

items.text: Kai was thirsty after the game, so he drank a big glass of ___.
items.why: A thirsty boy drinks water.

items.text: The baby was crying loudly. Her dad picked her up and sang a soft ___.
items.why: Dad sang a soft song.

items.text: The sandwich fell on the floor, so Ben decided not to eat it. It was no longer ___.
items.why: Food on the floor is not clean.

items.text: Max ran to catch the bus, but the doors closed before he got there. Now he would be ___ for school.
items.why: Missing the bus makes him late.

items.text: The bakery opened early. By noon, the shelves were ___ because everything had sold.
items.why: When everything is sold, shelves are empty.

items.text: The soccer game was close until the last minute, when Kai ___ the winning goal.
items.why: Kai scored the winning goal.

items.text: Ben's team practiced every day. On Saturday, they ___ the championship game.
items.why: All that practice helped them win.

items.text: Because the road was icy, drivers moved ___.
items.why: Drivers go slowly and carefully on ice.

items.text: A good friend listens carefully. When Mia was sad, Ava sat beside her and ___ to her story.
items.why: A good friend listens.

items.text: The astronaut floated inside the spaceship because there was no ___ in space.
items.why: Without gravity, things float.

items.text: The mouse was too small to reach the cheese. It had to ___ on a box to get it.
items.why: The mouse climbed up to reach the cheese.

items.text: The museum was full of ancient pots and tools. Kai felt like he was walking through ___.
items.why: Ancient things come from history.

items.text: Dark clouds covered the sky, and thunder shook the windows. The family decided to ___ the picnic.
items.why: A storm is a good reason to cancel a picnic.

items.text: Nora's garden needed water. She filled the can and ___ the thirsty flowers.
items.why: She watered the flowers.

items.text: The wolves howled at night. Their ___ echoed across the valley.
items.why: Howls are the sounds wolves make.

items.text: Although the test was difficult, Omar stayed calm and ___ each question carefully.
items.why: He read each question carefully.

items.text: The class hamster escaped, and the whole school helped ___ for it.
items.why: Everyone helped search for the hamster.

items.text: The tiny caterpillar ate leaves all summer. Then it spun a cocoon and later became a beautiful ___.
items.why: A caterpillar becomes a butterfly.

items.text: Max wanted to join the chess club, but he did not know how to play. He decided to ___ the rules first.
items.why: He needed to learn the rules.

items.text: The hikers ran out of water, so they were desperate to find a ___.
items.why: Thirsty hikers look for a stream.

items.text: After weeks of practice, Rosa's piano playing became smooth and ___.
items.why: Practice made her playing graceful.

items.text: Ava's experiment failed twice. Instead of giving up, she ___ and tried a new method.
items.why: She kept trying, which is persisting.

items.text: The judge listened to both sides before making a fair ___.
items.why: A judge makes a decision.

items.text: Scientists collected samples from the river to test whether the water was ___.
items.why: They tested if the water was polluted.

items.text: The inventor's first machine was clumsy, but each new version was more ___ than the last.
items.why: Each version worked better, so it was more efficient.

items.text: Because the pond had frozen solid, the children could ___ across it.
items.why: You can skate on frozen ice.

items.text: The explorers had no map, so they relied on the stars to ___ their way.
items.why: Stars help travelers navigate.

items.text: The sailors feared the approaching storm, so they ___ the ship into the harbor.
items.why: They steered the ship to safety.

items.text: Heavy rain caused the river to overflow. Soon the streets were ___ with water.
items.why: Overflowing rivers flood streets.

items.text: The recipe was so complicated that Nora needed to follow each step in the proper ___.
items.why: Steps must be done in order.

items.text: Grandma saved all her old photographs. They were precious ___ of her childhood.
items.why: Photographs hold memories.

items.text: The speaker's voice was so faint that people in the back row could barely ___ her.
items.why: A faint voice is hard to hear.

items.text: The scientist's findings contradicted what everyone believed. Many people were ___ at first.
items.why: Skeptical means not sure you believe it.

items.text: Though the mountain looked easy to climb from far away, the steep, rocky path proved ___ difficult.
items.why: Surprisingly means in a way you did not expect.

items.text: The detective carefully examined the evidence, hoping to ___ the mystery.
items.why: Detectives solve mysteries.

items.text: The author spent years researching the topic. As a result, her book was remarkably ___.
items.why: Years of research make a book thorough.

items.text: The mayor's plan was controversial; some residents supported it, while others strongly ___ it.
items.why: Some people supported it and others opposed it.
